name: Should I replace or reface cabinets during a kitchen refresh?

mainEntity.name: Should I replace or reface cabinets during a kitchen refresh?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to replace or reface cabinets depends on their existing condition and your budget. Refacing is a more budget-friendly option, ideal if the cabinet boxes are structurally sound. It involves updating doors, drawer fronts, and exterior finishes, giving a new look at a lower cost and faster timeline. Replacing cabinets is necessary if the existing boxes are damaged or if a completely new layout or higher-end material is desired. We can help you assess the best option.
acceptedAnswer.description: Reface cabinets if their boxes are sound and you seek a budget-friendly update; replace them if they're damaged or you want a new layout.
